morphology_keys.family_pattern: Cyperaceae/Carex: grasslike perennial sedges with sheathing leaves; Carex fruits are enclosed in a perigynium, a key structure for species-level identification.
morphology_keys.comparison_training: C. emoryi is the tall spreading wet-site species in this set. It differs from ravenfoot sedge by having distinct elongated separate spikes instead of one dense many-branched cylindrical head.
